items.title: Spy Mobs
items.creator: Magefall
items.description:
These mobs are have the latest in spy gear technologies, perfect for hiding in the shadows, secret heists, and any mission that nobody else can handle! Remember, don't blow your cover!

- 8 spy mob skins!

This skin set includes:

- Creeper
- Spider
- Pig
- Slime
- Piglin
- Enderman
- Zombie
- Skeleton

items.title: Spring Ducklings
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
Quack quack! Hop out of the pond and into the mines with the Spring Ducklings skin pack! Enjoy the sun on your feathers and the torchlight on your beak.

- 9 quack-cellent skins
- By 57Digital

items.title: Spots & Stripes
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
Stand out from the crowd with these snazzy patterned skins!

- Hand-crafted HD skins
- Inspired by geometric patterns
- By 57Digital

items.title: Spies
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
Spy on your frenemies with this collection of spy teen skins!

- Hand-crafted HD skins
- Inspired by spies!
- By 57Digital

items.title: Black and White Fashion
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
Stand out from the crowd with these gorgeously hand-crafted black and white inspired fashion outfits!

- Hand-crafted HD skins
- By 57Digital

items.title: Dragon Warriors!
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
Become a brutally powerful Dragon Warrior!
Equip your chosen skin and engage in mighty battles with your friends either with or against dragons!

+ 12 fierce and courageous skins with 2 that are FREE!
+ Includes mighty warrior character skins!

items.title: Ninja Mobs
items.creator: Entity Builds
items.description: Are you ready for the sneakiest mobs in Minecraft to come into play? Introducing Ninja Mobs! The stealthiest, coolest, and most well-trained fighters in the game! This clan has gone through intense ninja training to become the most lethal in any dojo. Show off how much of a ninja you can be as you parkour, fight, and win with these fun warriors.

items.title: Grunge
items.creator: Entity Builds
items.description:
Are you bored of the same bright and colorful skins seen over and over again in Minecraft? Get ready to be different! Pick from a variety of dark-clothed skins that know their style and rock it. Rule the streets of the city, the depths of the nether, or just show how hardcore you are with the Grunge skin pack

~Unique palette of skins
~Tough skins for tough players

items.title: Kings Vs. Pigs
items.creator: Code Zealot Studios LLC
items.description:
It's Kings Vs Pigs and the war is on! Which side will you choose? Roleplay as a King, Queen, Princess, Magician, or Warrior!

- 10 awesome skins (5 included for each faction)!
- Great for PVP and Roleplaying with your friends!
- Cartoony and Fantasy themed!
- By: Code Zealot Studios LLC

items.title: Ultra Armor
items.creator: Nitric Concepts
items.description:
Ultra armor is the best among us!

- 24 HD skins

items.title: Mob Blocks One Block Challenge
items.creator: Lifeboat
items.description:
Mobs have transformed into blocks! Break a pig block to collect pork chops. Mine a creeper block and get gunpowder. Each time a block is broken, a new one will take its place. Use blocks you collect to build the world around you.
- 37 custom mob blocks
- 20 skyblock islands
- Original and skyblock game modes

Challenge yourself and survive with limited resources.

items.title: Gorilla vs. T-Rex
items.creator: Lifeboat
items.description:
Oh no, there goes Tokyo! Those mystic monsters of movie fame, T-Rex and the Giant Gorilla, are after each other and destroying the evacuated city. Save the city before they ruin it completely!

5 vehicles and aircraft; one can even launch TNT
Monsters destroy buildings and smash cars
Jetpacks
Call in airstrikes
Place TNT mines
5 skins


The legend continues!

items.title: DEMON PROS
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description:
Time to become a DEMON PRO! These demon style skins have scary horns. These teens are not playing around...

+ Includes 7 demon skins
+ Fun to use on servers or single player worlds

items.title: Billionaire Teens
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
These billionaire teens have it all, giant mansions, awesome super cars, and all the latest fashion from their favorite brands!

- 8 billionaire skins!
- Wide variety of skin designs and outfits!

items.title: Teen Style!
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
These teens are going out and are wearing all of their favorite brands! Looking good!

- 8 fashionable skins!
- Wide variety of skins and outfits so you can choose one that suits you best!

items.title: Animal Teens
items.creator: DogHouse
items.description:
Do you like animals? Then this skinpack is perfect for you! Choose your favorite animal costume from 8 stylish HD skins. Impress your friends with a new look and feel like a real teen!

- Stylish HD Skins
- 8 different animal costumes
- By bdotpeach and oectway

items.title: BIG MOB WORLD
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description:
This world has super BIG mobs. Can you survive this world with super big Minecraft animals and hostile creatures? These supersize giant mobs make a fun adventure!

- Supersized big mobs
- The world includes a giant castle and village for you to explore and customize

items.title: Space Groove
items.creator: Ready, Set, Block!
items.description:
The teens are back from Mars and brought the most significant fashion trends with them! They have been to the stars and back and came across new fashion trends and dance moves. Come out and dance! 

+ 1 free skin 
+ 12 skins 
+ By Ready, Set, Block!

items.title: Chess Battle
items.creator: Diveblocks
items.description:
The first ever Minecraft chess in the entire marketplace comes to life in Chess Battle. Play, learn and have fun with the most advanced game mechanics. Improve your skills challenging your friends on the checkered field!

- 3 sets recreated with unique locations.
- A complete guide book to learn basic movements.

items.title: SKY POWER
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description: SKY POWER unleashes a new style. Time to travel through the sky with your new identity and become the most powerful player you can be. The world is yours!

items.title: Luxury Teens
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description:
Time to live in luxury. Flex your style with these millionaire teen skins.

- Includes 10 rich skins
- Great for roleplay

By: Pickaxe Studios

items.title: Cat Style
items.creator: UnderBlocks Studios
items.description: Show among your friends the Cat Style!

items.title: Find Da Right Button
items.creator: Giggle Block Studios
items.description:
Are you ready for a new twist to our classic find the button escape room challenges? Prepare yourself for some awesome new challenges as you must find not only a button, but the correct button! This is no time to be carefree, your choices matter! 
* 20 challenging levels!
* Multiplayer friendly!
By Giggle Block Studios!

items.title: Modern Mobs
items.creator: House of How
items.description: These modern mobs, are arriving from the digital realm with with a new, modern, cool look! 15 colorful, futuristic skins that are out of this galaxy!
